verdict.rationale: Terraform's official MCP server is documented to give AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules and policies, and HashiCorp says it "enables more accurate and actionable Terraform configuration generation." That is first-party AI support aimed at this story, but the natural-language-to-code generation itself happens in an external AI client rather than in Terraform. missing for 10: a native NL-to-HCL generation feature built into the CLI or HCP Terraform, documentation of the generation workflow itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of code-generation quality.
